decisions.reason: After the 2024 pruning of adjacent offers, this standalone gas tariff comparison remains very close to the firm's core utility-market and tariff capabilities and still looks commercially relevant.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is tightly aligned with the firm's established billing and tariff expertise and is likely to stay as a core platform component for utility customers.
This site-specific energy tariff comparison still fits the firm's niche, but its lighter website presence and overlap with other retained tariff tools keep its withdrawal risk noticeably higher.
